import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from pathlib import Path
CORPUS = Path('/Users/bobsingor/GitHub/cloudpdf-platform/oss/embedpdf/packages/engine/main/test/fixtures/signature-compat')
sys.path.insert(0, str(CORPUS))
from generate import A, D, N, S, g, signer_for, stream, describe_bytes, reader, raw_body
from generate_v3 import fresh, seal, edit
from generate_v2 import page_of
from verify_v3 import normalized, changed_keys
from asn1crypto import cms
import json, subprocess, hashlib
OUT = Path('/tmp/epdf-weak-nm-probes/pdfs')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert not any(OUT.iterdir()), 'Refuse to overwrite probe bytes'
signer = signer_for(CORPUS / 'keys')
cases = []
for profile in ['approval', 'p3', 'p2', 'fieldmdp', 'lockp2', 'locked-markup']:
  for layout in ['inline', 'indirect-array']:
    w = fresh(profile=profile)
    page = page_of(w)
    annots = page['/Annots']
    for index in range(4):
      appearance = stream(w, 'q 0 0 1 RG 1 w 1 1 58 38 re S Q', Type=N('/XObject'), Subtype=N('/Form'), BBox=A(0,0,60,40), Resources=D())
      annots.append(D(Type=N('/Annot'), Subtype=N('/Square'), Rect=A(310+index*65, 420, 370+index*65,460), F=g.NumberObject(132 if profile == 'locked-markup' and index == 2 else 4), C=A(0,0,1), Contents=S(f'weak-{index}'), AP=D(N=appearance)))
    if layout == 'indirect-array':
      page[N('/Annots')] = w.add_object(annots)
    if profile == 'lockp2':
      from generate import field_ref
      # The signer below preserves this signed /Lock /P declaration.
      field_ref(w, 'SignatureOne').get_object()[N('/Lock')] = D(Type=N('/SigFieldLock'), Action=N('/All'), P=g.NumberObject(2))
    base = seal(w, signer, certification=3 if profile=='p3' else 2 if profile=='p2' else None, lock=['ValueOne'] if profile=='fieldmdp' else None)
    old = reader(base)
    old_page = page_of(old)
    old_weak = {str(a['/Contents']): a for a in old_page['/Annots'] if isinstance(a, g.DictionaryObject) and a.get('/Subtype') == '/Square'}
    assert len(old_weak) == 4 and all('/NM' not in a for a in old_weak.values())
    for action in ['control', 'delete', 'delete-names', 'names', 'reorder', 'reorder-names']:
      def mutate(writer):
        target_page = page_of(writer)
        array = target_page['/Annots']
        if action.startswith('delete'):
          at = next(i for i,a in enumerate(array) if a.get_object().get('/Contents') == 'weak-1')
          array.pop(at)
        if action.startswith('reorder'):
          at = next(i for i,a in enumerate(array) if a.get_object().get('/Contents') == 'weak-3')
          item = array.pop(at)
          first = next(i for i,a in enumerate(array) if a.get_object().get('/Contents') == 'weak-0')
          array.insert(first,item)
        if 'names' in action:
          for a in array:
            if isinstance(a, g.DictionaryObject) and a.get('/Subtype') == '/Square' and not int(a.get('/F',0)) & 128:
              a[N('/NM')] = S('probe-' + str(a['/Contents']))
        raw = target_page.raw_get('/Annots')
        writer.mark_update(raw if isinstance(raw,g.IndirectObject) else writer.root['/Pages']['/Kids'].raw_get(0))
      data = base if action == 'control' else edit(base, mutate)
      new = reader(data)
      assert data.startswith(base)
      current = {str(a['/Contents']): a for a in page_of(new)['/Annots'] if isinstance(a,g.DictionaryObject) and a.get('/Subtype')=='/Square'}
      assert len(current) == (3 if action.startswith('delete') else 4)
      for name,a in current.items():
        expected = {'/NM'} if 'names' in action and not int(a.get('/F',0)) & 128 else set()
        assert changed_keys(old_weak[name], a) == expected, (profile,layout,action,name)
      # No field/widget object or appearance bytes were rewritten.
      for ref in old.root['/AcroForm']['/Fields']:
        assert raw_body(base,ref.idnum) == raw_body(data,ref.idnum)
      facts=describe_bytes(data)
      assert all(s['digestMatches'] for s in facts['signatures'])
      embedded = new.embedded_signatures[0]
      info=cms.ContentInfo.load(embedded.sig_object['/Contents'].original_bytes)
      ranges=embedded.sig_object['/ByteRange']
      signed = b''.join(data[int(ranges[i]):int(ranges[i])+int(ranges[i+1])] for i in range(0,len(ranges),2))
      sig_path=OUT/'check.cms'; content_path=OUT/'check.bin'
      sig_path.write_bytes(info.dump());content_path.write_bytes(signed)
      result=subprocess.run(['openssl','cms','-verify','-inform','DER','-in',str(sig_path),'-content',str(content_path),'-binary','-noverify','-out','/dev/null'],capture_output=True)
      assert result.returncode==0, result.stderr
      name=f'{profile}-{layout}-{action}'
      (OUT/f'{name}.pdf').write_bytes(data)
      cases.append(dict(id=name,profile=profile,layout=layout,action=action,file=f'{name}.pdf',facts=facts,acrobat='unobserved'))
for temporary in ['check.cms','check.bin']:(OUT/temporary).unlink()
(OUT/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(cases=cases,certificate=str(CORPUS/'keys/TEST-ONLY-signer.cer'),cmsVerified=len(cases)),indent=2)+'\n')
print(f'Generated {len(cases)} signed probes; exact-change checks and OpenSSL CMS verification passed for all.')
